messages:
Maya: Quick procurement question — we need a recommendation between ModelCostPro and CloudSpend before renewals. Can someone look at the attached cost comparison? https://rbw.in/sheets/vendor-eval (sheet has usage by team)
Ethan: I ran a topline. ModelCostPro offered 15% off for a 12‑month commit + free onboarding if we sign this month.
Leo: FYI infra note: CloudSpend's agent caused ~3% CPU bump at p99 during the Dec spike. ModelCostPro claims agentless, pulls from logs/metrics.
Priya: Legal: ModelCostPro's DPA mostly fine but subprocessor list is incomplete. CloudSpend requires SOC2 Type II evidence — do we have that on file?
Sasha: From product POV: ModelCostPro has realtime LLM-cost attribution and auto-tagging. CloudSpend's dashboards are more customizable though.
Maya: quick pricing snippet from my calc:
```
ModelCostPro:
  list: $60,000/yr
  commit12: $51,000/yr (-15%)
  onboarding: $5,000 one-time (waived if sign now)
CloudSpend:
  list: $48,000/yr + $2,000 seats
  estimated_overage: $6,000/yr
```
Jordan: Can we offset with Redwood Optimize credits? If we standardize metrics ingestion maybe we save ~10% on unit cost.
Ethan: Vendor update: ModelCostPro just replied — willing to do 20% on a 2‑yr commit and include 2 free seats. CloudSpend says they can match 15% on committed usage but no onboarding waiver.
Maya: Timeline: need finance sign-off by Friday for this month's procurement cycle. Who owns negotiations? @Ethan?
Ethan: I'll own it. I'll push for DPA + 20% multi‑year or onboarding waived. Looping Priya for DPA.
Priya: I'll review the DPA once Ethan shares the tracker. Also flagging data residency clause for Private deployment customers.
approvals-bot: Reminder: Contracts > $50k/yr require CFO + Legal approval. See policy: https://rbw.in/policy/procurement
Leo: Implementation ETA: ModelCostPro (agentless) ≈ 1 week to full parity for dashboards; CloudSpend requires installing agents on 10 infra hosts — ~2 engineers for 2 weeks.
Sasha: UX: ModelCostPro UI is cleaner for non-technical PMs; wins for adoption.
Maya: Plan: Ethan negotiates terms, Priya reviews DPA, Leo provides final infra impact estimate, Sasha confirms feature fit. I'll add this to the procurement tracker: https://rbw.in/sheets/procurement-tracker
Ethan: 👍 starting outreach now, will post updates in this thread.
